description: Four clock channels driven by one tempo, each multiplying or dividing it, with a sync input per channel and a chain jack for handing the tempo to another of these

params.text: Sets the main tempo, 60 to 220 beats per minute
Multiplies or divides the main tempo for that channel, from divide by 32, through unity, to multiply by 32
Nothing in the module applies this knob; a jitter value is computed from it and then never added to the clock

inputs.text: A rising edge here restarts that channel's clock on the next main beat
Takes the tempo and the run state from another MSC Clock, and while a cable is here the BPM knob is ignored

outputs.text: A 1ms 10V pulse at that channel's rate, silent while that channel or the whole module is stopped
A 1ms 10V pulse each time that channel is resynchronised
Carries this module's tempo and run state for another MSC Clock to follow

notes: the module clocks as soon as it is added, at the tempo the BPM knob is set to, and nothing has to be patched to it
the STOP button on a channel silences that channel's CLOCK jacks, and the global STOP button silences all four; the SYNC TRIGs jacks keep firing either way
the x2 button on a channel doubles the division it is set to, and changes nothing while that channel multiplies the tempo rather than dividing it
the global SYNC button restarts all four channels together on the next main beat

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
